description: Return the signed verdict for the project's attested/ctrf.json, built only from the Sigstore attestation that `gh attestation verify` accepts under the same run, ref, and head policy as the required check, plus the local receipt fields labelled unverified. Local runs are never attested; CI runs are.

cwd.description: Project directory to run in (default: the server working directory).

head_sha.description: Commit the receipt must cover (default: git HEAD).

run_id.description: Workflow run whose attestation is accepted (default: the latest completed run of the signer workflow for head_sha, from the GitHub API).

signer_workflow.description: owner/repo/.github/workflows/<file>.yml that must have signed it (default: <repo>/.github/workflows/attested.yml).

source_ref.description: Ref that run must have signed on (default: refs/pull/<N>/merge or refs/heads/<branch>, from that run).

name: attested_status
